notes.subject: הנני אליך
notes.rationale: Literally 'here I am to you', an idiom of hostile confrontation rendered 'mi kam long yu'; KJV 'I am against thee'.

notes.subject: רכבה (3fs suffix)
notes.rationale: 'Her chariots' — the feminine suffix points back to Nineveh though the address is masculine 'you'; some read it as collective.

notes.subject: כפיריך / טרפך
notes.rationale: The lion imagery of v.13 continues: young lions and prey of v.14 answer the whelps and prey of v.13.

notes.subject: Ninive
notes.rationale: Direct address to Nineveh (Assyria) in an oracle of judgment.

translation: Lukim, mi kam long yu, Yahwe Tsebaot i tok, na bai mi stingim olgeta long smok ol karia bilong ⟨en⟩, na bainat bai kaikai ⟨את⟩ ol yangpela laion bilong yu, na bai mi rausim ⟨את⟩ kaikai bilong yu long graun, na voes bilong ol mesinja bilong yu bai ol i no ken harim tumora.

tokens.gloss: na ol yangpela laion bilong yu
